unoptimized.strategy: two complete aggregations; per-submitted-field LEFT JOIN; separate count and result queries

optimized.strategy: field totals plus latest known judgments; single SQL with pagination metadata

method: Two separate disposable full-migration runs on the same host with equivalent linked workload; 3 warm-ups and 15 sequential API samples per run. Historical judgment volume is 24, not a million-judgment worst-case benchmark.
